text_en: When people began to multiply on the face of the ground, and daughters were born to them,
text_cn: 当人在地上开始繁殖，生养女儿时，

text_en: the sons of God saw that they were fair; and they took wives for themselves of all that they chose.
text_cn: 天主的儿子见人的女儿美丽，就随意选取，作为妻子。

text_en: Then the Lord said, “My spirit shall not abide in mortals forever, for they are flesh; their days shall be one hundred twenty years. ”
text_cn: 上主于是说：“因为人既属于血肉，我的神不能常在他内；他的寿数只可到一百二十岁。”

text_en: The Nephilim were on the earth in those days—and also afterward—when the sons of God went in to the daughters of humans, who bore children to them. These were the heroes that were of old, warriors of renown.
text_cn: 当天主的儿子与人的儿女结合生子时，在地上已有一些巨人，〔以后也有〕，他们就是古代的英雄，著名的人物。

text_en: The Lord saw that the wickedness of humankind was great in the earth, and that every inclination of the thoughts of their hearts was only evil continually.
text_cn: 上主见人在地上的罪恶重大，人心天天所思念的无非是邪恶；

text_en: And the Lord was sorry that he had made humankind on the earth, and it grieved him to his heart.
text_cn: 上主遂后悔在地上造了人，心中很是悲痛。

text_en: So the Lord said, “I will blot out from the earth the human beings I have created—people together with animals and creeping things and birds of the air, for I am sorry that I have made them. ”
text_cn: 上主于是说：“我要将我所造的人，连人带野兽、爬虫和天空的飞鸟，都由地面上消灭，因为我后悔造了他们。”

text_en: But Noah found favor in the sight of the Lord .
text_cn: 惟有诺厄在上主眼中蒙受恩爱。

text_en: These are the descendants of Noah. Noah was a righteous man, blameless in his generation; Noah walked with God.
text_cn: 以下是诺厄的小史：诺厄是他同时代惟一正义齐全的人，常同天主往来。

text_en: And Noah had three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
text_cn: 他生了三个儿子：就是闪、含、和耶斐特。

text_en: Now the earth was corrupt in God’s sight, and the earth was filled with violence.
text_cn: 大地已在天主面前败坏，到处充满了强暴。

text_en: And God saw that the earth was corrupt; for all flesh had corrupted its ways upon the earth.
text_cn: 天主见大地已败坏，因为凡有血肉的人，品行在地上全败坏了，

text_en: And God said to Noah, “I have determined to make an end of all flesh, for the earth is filled with violence because of them; now I am going to destroy them along with the earth.
text_cn: 天主遂对诺厄说：“我已决定要结果一切有血肉的人，因为他们使大地充满了强暴，我要将他们由大地上消灭。

text_en: Make yourself an ark of cypress wood; make rooms in the ark, and cover it inside and out with pitch.
text_cn: 你要用柏木造一只方舟，舟内建造一些舱房，内外都涂上沥青。

text_en: This is how you are to make it: the length of the ark three hundred cubits, its width fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits.
text_cn: 你要这样建造：方舟要有三百肘长，五十肘宽，三十肘高。

text_en: Make a roof for the ark, and finish it to a cubit above; and put the door of the ark in its side; make it with lower, second, and third decks.
text_cn: 方舟上层四面做上窗户，高一肘；门要安在侧面；方舟要分为上中下三层。

text_en: For my part, I am going to bring a flood of waters on the earth, to destroy from under heaven all flesh in which is the breath of life; everything that is on the earth shall die.
text_cn: 看我要使洪水在地上泛滥，消灭天下一切有生气的血肉；凡地上所有的都要灭亡。

text_en: But I will establish my covenant with you; and you shall come into the ark, you, your sons, your wife, and your sons’ wives with you.
text_cn: 但我要与你立约，你以及你的儿子、妻子和儿媳，要与你一同进入方舟。

text_en: And of every living thing, of all flesh, you shall bring two of every kind into the ark, to keep them alive with you; they shall be male and female.
text_cn: 你要由一切有血肉的生物中，各带一对，即一公一母，进入方舟，与你一同生活；

text_en: Of the birds according to their kinds, and of the animals according to their kinds, of every creeping thing of the ground according to its kind, two of every kind shall come in to you, to keep them alive.
text_cn: 各种飞鸟、各种牲畜、地上所有的各种爬虫，皆取一对同你进去，得以保存生命。

text_en: Also take with you every kind of food that is eaten, and store it up; and it shall serve as food for you and for them. ”
text_cn: 此外，你还应带上各种吃用的食物，贮存起来，作你和他们的食物。”

text_en: Noah did this; he did all that God commanded him.
text_cn: 诺厄全照办了；天主怎样吩咐了他，他就怎样做了。
